projects.title: To The Purest Soul (Mother's Day Tribute Site)
projects.tagline: A scroll-driven storytelling site made for my mom.
projects.desc: A one-page emotional storytelling website built as a Mother's Day gift: a scroll-triggered narrative moving through childhood photos, poetic captions, and a personal family story, ending in a closing tribute message.
